with report_version as (
    SELECT  MAX(version) AS max_version
    FROM ads_custody.t_deposit_withdraw_reconciliation_daily_report
    WHERE dt = '{{ logical_date | lymd }}'
    ---and ex_order_type = 'DEPOSIT'
   --- and ex_network = 'BTC'
)
select
    coalesce(report_version.max_version, 0) + 1                                   as version,
    xxx.*,
    case when ex_amount - jp_amount=0 then '0.000000000000000000'
     else ex_amount - jp_amount
     end as gap_amount_ex_jp,
    case when ex_miner_fee - jp_miner_fee=0 then '0.000000000000000000'
     else ex_miner_fee - jp_miner_fee
     end as gap_miner_fee_ex_jp,
    case when ex_amount - bc_amount=0 then '0.000000000000000000'
    else ex_amount - bc_amount
    end as gap_amount_ex_bc,
    case when ex_miner_fee - bc_miner_fee=0 then '0.000000000000000000'
     else ex_miner_fee - bc_miner_fee
     end as gap_miner_fee_ex_bc,
    case when jp_amount - bc_amount=0 then '0.000000000000000000'
    else jp_amount - bc_amount
    end as gap_amount_jp_bc,
    case when jp_miner_fee - bc_miner_fee=0 then '0.000000000000000000'
     else jp_miner_fee - bc_miner_fee
    end  as gap_miner_fee_jb_bc
from report_version cross join (

    select
        twio.from_side                                  as ex_from_wallet_type,
        coalesce(tdo.account_id,'')                       as ex_account_id,
        101                                             as ex_order_state,
        'DEPOSIT'                                       as ex_order_type,
        twio.order_hash                                 as ex_hash,
        twio.from_address                               as ex_from_wallet_address,
        twio.asset_id                                   as ex_asset_type,
        twio.network                                    as ex_network,
        coalesce(twio.amount,0)                           as ex_amount,
        coalesce(twio.fee,0) + coalesce(twio_fee.fee,0)                              as ex_miner_fee,
        twio.fee_asset_id                               as ex_miner_fee_type,
        twio.transaction_time                           as ex_transaction_time,
        twio.to_side                                    as ex_to_wallet_type,
        twio.to_address                                 as ex_to_wallet_address,

        jpo.state                                       as jp_order_state,
        jpo.hash                                        as jp_hash,
        jpo.`from`                                      as jp_from_wallet_address,
        twio.asset_id                                   as jp_asset_type,
        jpo.`type`                                      as jp_network,
        coalesce(cast(jpo.value as decimal(38,18)),0)                             as jp_amount,
        coalesce(cast(jpo.fee as decimal(38,18)),0)
          + coalesce(cast(jpo_spend_special.value as decimal(38,18)),0) as jp_miner_fee,
        twio.fee_asset_id      as jp_miner_fee_type,
        jpo.create_at                                   as jp_transaction_time,
        jpo.`to`                                        as jp_to_wallet_address,

        jpo.hash                                        as bc_hash,
        jpo.`from`                                      as bc_from_wallet_address,
        twio.asset_id                                   as bc_asset_type,
        jpo.`type`                                      as bc_network,
        coalesce(cast(jpo.value as decimal(38,18)),0)                             as bc_amount,
        coalesce(cast(jpo.fee as decimal(38,18)),0)
          + coalesce(cast(jpo_spend_special.value as decimal(38,18)),0) as bc_miner_fee,
        CAST(get_json_object(jpo.fees, '$[0].coinName') AS STRING)       as bc_miner_fee_type,
        from_unixtime(cast(jpo.create_at/1000 as bigint), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')         as bc_transaction_time,
        jpo.`to`                                        as bc_to_wallet_address,
        twio.org_id
    from (
        select * from ods_custody_onl.t_deposit_order
        where is_delete = 0
        and arrival_status = 1
        and block_time is not null
        and date_format(from_unixtime(cast(block_time/1000 as bigint)),'yyyy-MM-dd') = '{{ logical_date | lymd }}'
    ) tdo
    inner join (
        select * from ods_custody_onl.t_wallet_inout_order
        where is_delete = 0
        and order_type = 1
        and network = 'BTC'
    ) twio
    on twio.out_order_id = tdo.source_id and twio.org_id = tdo.org_id
    left join (
        select io_id, org_id,sum(amount) fee from
        ods_custody_onl.t_wallet_inout_order_detail
        where cast(order_type as int) between 4000 and 4999
        and is_delete = 0
        group by io_id,org_id
    ) twio_fee
    on twio.io_id = twio_fee.io_id and twio.org_id = twio_fee.org_id
    left join ods_jade_pool.t_order jpo
    on twio.out_order_id = jpo.jp_id and twio.org_id = jpo.org_id
    left join (
        select * from ods_jade_pool.t_order
        where biz_type = 'SPEND_SPECIAL'
    ) jpo_spend_special on jpo_spend_special.hash = twio.order_hash and  jpo_spend_special.org_id = twio.org_id
    union all
    select
        twio.from_side                                                              as ex_from_wallet_type,
        coalesce(tdo.account_id,'')                                                   as ex_account_id,
        101 as ex_order_state,
        'DEPOSIT'                                                                   as ex_order_type,
        twio.order_hash                                                             as ex_hash,
        twio.from_address                                                           as ex_from_wallet_address,
        twio.asset_id                                                               as ex_asset_type,
        twio.network                                                                as ex_network,
        coalesce(twio.amount,0)                                                       as ex_amount,
        coalesce(twio.fee,0) + coalesce(twio_fee.fee,0)                                                        as ex_miner_fee,
        twio.fee_asset_id                                                           as ex_miner_fee_type,
        twio.transaction_time                                                       as ex_transaction_time,
        twio.to_side                                                                as ex_to_wallet_type,
        twio.to_address                                                             as ex_to_wallet_address,

        jpo.state                                                                   as jp_order_state,
        jpo.hash                                                                    as jp_hash,
        jpo.`from`                                                                  as jp_from_wallet_address,
        twio.asset_id                                                               as jp_asset_type,
        jpo.`type`                                                                  as jp_network,
        coalesce(cast(jpo.value as decimal(38,18)),0)                                                         as jp_amount,
        coalesce(cast(jpo.fee as decimal(38,18)),0)
         + coalesce(cast(jpo_spend_special.value as decimal(38,18)),0)              as jp_miner_fee,
        twio.fee_asset_id                                  as jp_miner_fee_type,
        jpo.create_at                                                               as jp_transaction_time,
        jpo.`to`                                                                    as jp_to_wallet_address,

        jpo.hash                                                                    as bc_hash,
        jpo.`from`                                                                  as bc_from_wallet_address,
        twio.asset_id                                                               as bc_asset_type,
        jpo.`type`                                                                  as bc_network,
        coalesce(cast(jpo.value as decimal(38,18)),0)                                                         as bc_amount,
        coalesce(cast(jpo.fee as decimal(38,18)),0)
         + coalesce(cast(jpo_spend_special.value as decimal(38,18)),0) as bc_miner_fee,
        twio.fee_asset_id                                  as bc_miner_fee_type,
        from_unixtime(cast(jpo.create_at/1000 as bigint), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')                      as bc_transaction_time,
        jpo.`to`                                                                    as bc_to_wallet_address,
        twio.org_id
    from (
        select * from ods_custody_onl.t_wallet_inout_order
        where is_delete = 0
        and order_type = 1
        and network != 'BTC'
    ) twio
    left join (
        select io_id, org_id,sum(amount) fee from
        ods_custody_onl.t_wallet_inout_order_detail
        where cast(order_type as int) between 4000 and 4999
        and is_delete = 0
        group by io_id,org_id
    ) twio_fee
    on twio.io_id = twio_fee.io_id and twio.org_id = twio_fee.org_id
    inner join (
        select * from ods_custody_onl.t_deposit_order
        where is_delete = 0
        and arrival_status = 1
        and block_time is not null
        and date_format(from_unixtime(cast(block_time/1000 as bigint)),'yyyy-MM-dd') = '{{ logical_date | lymd }}'
    ) tdo on twio.out_order_id = tdo.source_id and twio.org_id = tdo.org_id
    left join ods_jade_pool.t_order jpo
    on twio.out_order_id = jpo.jp_id and twio.org_id = jpo.org_id
    left join (
        select * from ods_jade_pool.t_order
        where biz_type = 'SPEND_SPECIAL'
    ) jpo_spend_special on jpo_spend_special.hash = twio.order_hash and jpo_spend_special.org_id = twio.org_id
    union all
    select
        twio.from_side                                  as ex_from_wallet_type,
        coalesce(tdo.account_id,'')                       as ex_account_id,
        101                                             as ex_order_state,
        'WITHDRAW'                                      as ex_order_type,
        twio.order_hash                                 as ex_hash,
        twio.from_address                               as ex_from_wallet_address,
        twio.asset_id                                   as ex_asset_type,
        twio.network                                    as ex_network,
        coalesce(twio.amount, 0)                          as ex_amount,
        coalesce(twio.fee, 0) + coalesce(twio_fee.fee, 0)                            as ex_miner_fee,
        twio.fee_asset_id                               as ex_miner_fee_type,
        twio.transaction_time                           as ex_transaction_time,
        twio.to_side                                    as ex_to_wallet_type,

        jpo.state                                       as jp_order_state,

        coalesce(cast(jpo.value as decimal(38,18)),0)                             as jp_amount,
        coalesce(cast(jpo.fee as decimal(38,18)),0)
         + coalesce(cast(jpo_spend_special.value as decimal(38,18)),0)                               as jp_miner_fee,
        twio.fee_asset_id      as jp_miner_fee_type,
        jpo.create_at                                   as jp_transaction_time,
        jpo.`to`                                        as jp_to_wallet_address,

        jpo.hash                                        as bc_hash,
        jpo.`from`                                      as bc_from_wallet_address,
        twio.asset_id                                   as bc_asset_type,
        jpo.`type`                                      as bc_network,
        coalesce(cast(jpo.value as decimal(38,18)),0)                             as bc_amount,
        coalesce(cast(jpo.fee as decimal(38,18)),0)
         + coalesce(cast(jpo_spend_special.value as decimal(38,18)),0)                               as bc_miner_fee,
        twio.fee_asset_id      as bc_miner_fee_type,
        from_unixtime(cast(jpo.create_at/1000 as bigint), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')      as bc_transaction_time,
        jpo.`to`                                        as bc_to_wallet_address,
        twio.org_id

    from (
        select * from ods_custody_onl.t_withdraw_order
        where is_delete = 0
        and arrival_status = 2
        and block_time is not null
        and date_format(from_unixtime(cast(block_time/1000 as bigint)),'yyyy-MM-dd') = '{{ logical_date | lymd }}'
    ) tdo
    inner join (

        and is_delete = 0

    ) twio_fee
    on twio.io_id = twio_fee.io_id and twio.org_id = twio_fee.org_id
    left join ods_jade_pool.t_order jpo on twio.out_order_id = jpo.jp_id and twio.org_id = jpo.org_id
    left join (
        select * from ods_jade_pool.t_order
        where biz_type = 'SPEND_SPECIAL'
    ) jpo_spend_special on jpo_spend_special.hash = twio.order_hash and  jpo_spend_special.org_id = twio.org_id
    union all

        twio.from_side                                                              as ex_from_wallet_type,
        coalesce(tdo.account_id,'')                                                   as ex_account_id,
        101                                                                         as ex_order_state,
        'WITHDRAW'                                                                  as ex_order_type,
        twio.order_hash                                                             as ex_hash,
        twio.from_address                                                           as ex_from_wallet_address,
        twio.asset_id                                                               as ex_asset_type,

        twio.fee_asset_id                                                           as ex_miner_fee_type,
        twio.transaction_time                                                       as ex_transaction_time,
        twio.to_side                                                                as ex_to_wallet_type,

        jpo.state                                                                   as jp_order_state,
        jpo.hash                                                                    as jp_hash,
        jpo.`from`                                                                  as jp_from_wallet_address,
        twio.asset_id                                                               as jp_asset_type,
        jpo.`type`                                                                  as jp_network,
        coalesce(cast(jpo.value as decimal(38,18)),0)                                                         as jp_amount,
        coalesce(cast(jpo.fee as decimal(38,18)),0)
         + coalesce(cast(jpo_spend_special.value as decimal(38,18)),0)                                                           as jp_miner_fee,
        twio.fee_asset_id                                  as jp_miner_fee_type,
        jpo.create_at                                                               as jp_transaction_time,

        jpo.`from`                                                                  as bc_from_wallet_address,

        coalesce(cast(jpo.value as decimal(38,18)),0)                                                         as bc_amount,

    ) twio

CREATE TABLE `t_deposit_withdraw_reconciliation_daily_report` (
  `dt` date NULL COMMENT "快照日期",
  `version` bigint(20) NULL COMMENT "报告版本",
  `ex_hash` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "交易所后台-交易哈希值",
  `ex_from_wallet_type` bigint(20) NULL COMMENT "交易所后台-来源钱包类型",
  `ex_account_id` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "交易所后台-账户id",
  `ex_order_state` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "交易所后台-订单状态",
  `ex_order_type` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "交易所后台-订单类型",
  `ex_from_wallet_address` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "交易所后台-来源钱包地址",
  `ex_asset_type` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "交易所后台-资产类型",
  `ex_network` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "交易所后台-区块链",
  `ex_amount` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "交易所后台-充提金额",
  `ex_miner_fee` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "交易所后台-矿工费",
  `ex_miner_fee_type` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "交易所后台-矿工费币种",
  `ex_transaction_time` bigint(20) NULL COMMENT "交易所后台-交易时间",
  `ex_to_wallet_type` bigint(20) NULL COMMENT "交易所后台-去向钱包类型",
  `ex_to_wallet_address` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "交易所后台-去向钱包地址",
  `jp_order_state` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "瑶池-订单状态",
  `jp_hash` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "瑶池-交易哈希值",
  `jp_from_wallet_address` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "瑶池-来源钱包地址",
  `jp_asset_type` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "瑶池-资产类型",
  `jp_network` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "瑶池-区块链",
  `jp_amount` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "瑶池-充提金额",
  `jp_miner_fee` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "瑶池-矿工费",
  `jp_miner_fee_type` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "瑶池-矿工费币种",
  `jp_transaction_time` bigint(20) NULL COMMENT "瑶池-交易时间",
  `jp_to_wallet_address` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "瑶池-去向钱包地址",
  `bc_hash` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "区块连浏览器-交易哈希值",
  `bc_from_wallet_address` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "区块连浏览器-来源钱包地址",
  `bc_asset_type` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "区块连浏览器-资产类型",
  `bc_network` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "区块连浏览器-区块链",
  `bc_amount` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "区块连浏览器-充提金额",
  `bc_miner_fee` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "区块连浏览器-矿工费",
  `bc_miner_fee_type` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "区块连浏览器-矿工费币种",
  `bc_transaction_time` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "区块连浏览器-交易时间",
  `bc_to_wallet_address` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "区块连浏览器-去向钱包地址",
  `gap_amount_ex_jp` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "金额轧差-交易所后台-钱包托管",
  `gap_miner_fee_ex_jp` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "手续费轧差-交易所后台-钱包托管",
  `gap_amount_ex_bc` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "金额轧差-交易所后台-区块链浏览器",
  `gap_miner_fee_ex_bc` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "手续费轧差-交易所后台-区块链浏览器",
  `gap_amount_jp_bc` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "金额轧差-钱包托管-区块链浏览器",
  `gap_miner_fee_jb_bc` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "手续费轧差-钱包托管-区块链浏览器",
  `org_id` bigint(20) NULL COMMENT "组织ID"
) ENGINE=OLAP 
DUPLICATE KEY(`dt`, `version`, `ex_hash`)
COMMENT "充提明细核对表"
PARTITION BY RANGE(`dt`)

  `sys_upd_datetime` datetime NULL COMMENT "系统更新时间",

  `flow_state` bigint(20) NULL COMMENT "流程状态机编号",

  `to_side` bigint(20) NULL COMMENT "接收方",
  `arrive_timestamp` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "充值到账时间戳",
  `block_time` bigint(20) NULL COMMENT "瑶池上链时间",
  `sign` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "充值订单信息签名",
  `history_asset_flag` bigint(20) NULL COMMENT "历史资产标记 1:是 0:否",
  `verify_address_signature_res` bigint(20) NULL COMMENT "2充值白名单验证签名失败",
  `business_type` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "业务类型 Judicial:司法处置",
  `checksum` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "数据唯一性校验",
  `checksum_id` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "数据唯一性校验id",
  `deposit_failed_reason` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "充值失败信息",
  `vasp_info` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "vasp信息",
  `log_index` varchar(65533) NULL COMMENT "链上log_index",
  `from_bridge` bigint(20) NULL COMMENT "是否来自custody_bridge回调",
  `admin_refund_flag` bigint(20) NULL COMMENT "是否进入后管退款: 0:否, 1:是",
  `org_id` bigint(20) NULL COMMENT "org_id标志站点，BMA：9001，UAE：9002",
  `group_user_id` bigint(20) NULL COMMENT "group UID",
  `user_id` bigint(20) NULL COMMENT "UID",
  `master_id` bigint(20) NULL COMMENT "Master ID",
  `trader_id` bigint(20) NULL COMMENT "Trader ID",
  `dw_vt` bigint(20) NULL COMMENT "",
  `dw_op` char(1) NULL COMMENT "",
  `dw_fpt` bigint(20) NULL COMMENT "",
  `dw_block` varchar(64) NULL COMMENT "",
  `dw_offset` bigint(20) NULL COMMENT ""

"enable_persistent_index" = "true",
"fast_schema_evolution" = "true",
"replicated_storage" = "true",
"replication_num" = "1"
);
